paite: Ngai in, unaute kituak diamdiam a omkhawm anak hoih in, anuam mahmah hi!
heading: David La / Unau Ki-itna Phatna
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

paite: Lu a thau manphatak, khamul a luangkhia, Aaron khamul ngei a luangkhia a, apuanaktual mong a luangkhia bang ahi.
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

paite: Hermon daitui chiim Zion tangte a ke zel bang ahi; huai ah ToUPA'N vualzawlna thu apia a, tangtawn a hinna ding ngei.
english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
